name: github-pr-status
description: A pane beside the chat showing this branch's GitHub pull request, review state and CI checks

token.title: GitHub token
token.description: Optional. A token that can read pull requests, checks and commit statuses. Needed for private repositories, and raises GitHub's rate limit. Left empty, the plugin tries GITHUB_TOKEN, GH_TOKEN, then `gh auth token`.

refreshSeconds.title: Refresh interval (seconds)
refreshSeconds.description: How often the open pane checks GitHub. At least 300 without a token.
